einzeiler: A decorated NYPD officer plotted to murder her ex-husband and a teenager.
kurzfassung: In 2019, an NYPD officer named Valerie Cincinnati plotted to have her estranged husband Isaiah Carvalho and her boyfriend's teenage daughter murdered. After her boyfriend went to the FBI and cooperated with an undercover sting, authorities faked Isaiah's death to catch her. Valerie ultimately took a plea deal and served four years in prison for obstruction of justice.
stichpunkte: Valerie Cincinnati and Isaiah Carvalho separated in 2019 after a troubled marriage that included domestic disputes and an earlier affair Valerie had with a man named John DeRuba.
During her relationship with John, Valerie exhibited extreme jealousy toward his teenage daughter and eventually threatened John with a firearm.
John reported Valerie to internal affairs, leading to her demotion and the temporary end of their relationship, though they later reconciled after John temporarily recanted under pressure.
As divorce proceedings progressed and financial disputes arose over her pension, Valerie began asking John to help her hire a hitman to eliminate both Isaiah and John's daughter.
John secretly recorded conversations with Valerie and handed over seven thousand dollars in cash that Valerie provided for the intended hit.
The FBI stepped in, wired John to gather more evidence, and staged photos of a murdered Isaiah in a parking lot to make Valerie believe the plot had succeeded.
Police confronted Valerie with news of Isaiah's death, and immediately after officers left, she urged John to delete their digital communications.
Authorities arrested Valerie immediately afterward, and in April 2021 she pleaded guilty to obstruction of justice, receiving a four-year prison sentence.

clips.hook: A decorated domestic violence officer accused her husband of abuse.
clips.text: Despite working in the police department's domestic violence division and projecting a tough image, Valerie claimed to her new boyfriend that her husband was abusive toward her.

clips.hook: A chance encounter while washing a car sparked a secret affair.
clips.text: The illicit romance began when Valerie shouted flirtations from her patrol car to a random man washing his vehicle outside a home in Queens.

clips.hook: An argument over a text message turned into a gun pointed at a face.
clips.text: After finding her boyfriend texting someone else, the police officer retrieved her firearm from a bag and threatened him directly.

clips.hook: Thousands of dollars exchanged hands for a deadly contract.
clips.text: Believing she was funding a professional assassination plot, the suspect withdrew a large sum of cash from her bank account and handed it over.

clips.hook: A murder plot resulted in just four years behind bars.
clips.text: Following her guilty plea to obstruction charges rather than murder-for-hire, the offender served a relatively short prison sentence before being released.

beschreibung:
On this episode, Garrett and Payton explore the case of Isaiah Carvalho. When Isaiah, the husband of a police officer, is found dead inside his car, the investigation takes an unusual turn, because police already know exactly who did it.
